Class NoSer

  • Object
    • NoSer

  • public class NoSer
extends Object
    class translating the classes VertexCopy, EdgeCopy and DiagramCopy, which were Serializable in Java, to and from JSON-compatible data (see class NoSer in the Java-version); used in reading launchdata and in getState/setState.
